subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@zenhealth.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks again for today's kickoff — great conversation and excited to get the POC running. Below is a concise recap, agreed scope, success metrics, owners, timeline, and access/setup steps. Please reply with any corrections; otherwise we'll proceed to the Week 1 tasks and send calendar invites.

Scope
- Integrate Redwood Inference hosted API for clinical note summarization (batch + realtime API endpoints).
- Provide a prompt set + eval harness to measure summary quality on ZenHealth clinical notes (de-identified).
- Deliver a final report with recommendations (quantization/profile, batching, cost estimates) and a README for production handoff.

Success metrics (POC)
- Functional: process sample batch of 10k notes and realtime latency < 300 ms (95th) for single-note summarization (staging).
- Quality: achieve >= 90% pass rate on the evaluation rubric across a 200-prompt test set (we'll share rubric).
- Cost target: aim to reduce current token cost by >= 25% compared to your baseline (we'll run A/B config).

Owners (POC)
- ZenHealth: Sanjay Patel (Product lead), Elena Torres (Engineering lead), Procurement: procurement@zenhealth.com
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, project owner), Aditya Rao (Solutions Eng, integration & evals), Rishi Malhotra (Platform eng, infra & access)

Timeline & milestones (4-week POC)
- Week 0 (by Fri Nov 13): access + sample data delivered; staging API key provisioned; network allowlist configured.
- Week 1 (Nov 15–21): data onboarding, prompt set assembly, initial eval runs.
- Week 2 (Nov 22–28): integration of realtime endpoint, performance tuning, continued evals.
- Week 3 (Nov 29–Dec 5): finalization of metrics, cost estimates, start of handoff docs.
- Week 4 (by Dec 7): POC demo + final report; decision point for next steps.

Access / setup steps (action items for ZenHealth)
1) Share a staging S3 URL with de-identified sample notes or grant an IAM role with read access (Aditya will send a template role).
2) Provide a list of IPs to allowlist (or confirm VPC peering if using private deployment).
3) Confirm a user in ZenHealth to be the primary API contact (we recorded Elena during the call).
4) Please confirm whether you prefer our hosted API keys (fastest) or a dedicated VPC deployment for the POC — we recommended hosted to speed onboarding.

Attachments shared: draft SOW (ZenHealth_POC_SOW_v1.pdf), Redwood security pack (redwood-security-pack.zip), access instructions (access-instructions.md).

Next steps
- Marissa to send SOW and security pack (attached).
- ZenHealth to provide staging S3 or IAM role and allowlist by Fri Nov 13.
- Schedule weekly 30-min sync (Marissa suggested Tue 9am PT) — proposed invite to follow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenhealth.com>, procurement@zenhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and captures the discussion. A few quick notes / asks from our side: 

- Confirming Elena will lead the integration and I'll own product sign-off.
- Procurement copied; they need the SOW in Word format and a PO estimate (ballpark cost for the 4-week POC + potential discount for a first-time pilot).
- Can you confirm Redwood's SOC2 scope and whether the security pack includes details on data retention and encryption-at-rest keys? Procurement will want that.
- We prefer hosted API keys initially to move quickly. If the hosted route has any data residency concerns we should flag them now.

Action items for ZenHealth: Elena will provision a staging S3 with 2,000 de-identified notes by Nov 13 and provide an IAM role. Procurement will review SOW once we have Word copy.

Also agree to Tue 9am PT weekly sync — works for us.

Sanjay
Head of Product | ZenHealth
sanjay@zenhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@zenhealth.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, procurement@zenhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-08T12:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps

Appreciate the fast reply, Sanjay — good to hear Elena will lead engineering. Answers below and attached the Word SOW per procurement's request.

- SOC2 / security: the attached redwood-security-pack.zip includes our SOC 2 Type II coverage summary, encryption details (KMS/HSM options), data retention defaults, and network architecture diagrams. Rishi can jump on a short call if your security team has follow-ups.
- Hosted API: good — hosted keys are fine and will not persist any PII beyond the evaluation window. We'll share our standard data handling addendum; if you need stricter residency/retention settings we can enable them in the project config.
- PO estimate: for the 4-week POC we typically bill a fixed pilot fee $25,000 which covers reserved capacity, SRE support, and dedicated SE time for integration and eval runs. If procurement needs a different structure (time & materials) we can provide that too.

Attachments: ZenHealth_POC_SOW_v1.docx, redwood-security-pack.zip, access-instructions.md

I've created the weekly calendar invite for Tue 9am PT starting Nov 16 and shared the HubSpot deal link (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521). Please confirm receipt of the invite and the S3 / IAM details by Friday Nov 13 so Aditya can begin the onboarding.

—
